verdict.description: approve: place the trade, with the stop and targets below where they are given. reject: do not place it; the note says why.

stop_loss.description: Present when the person moved the stop: the stop loss to use instead of the proposed one.

take_profit.description: Present when the person moved a target: every target to use, in the proposal's order, instead of the proposed ones.

note.description: What the person said about it.
